title: [Modern] Luxurious living mansion (at 'WOK' and  'Minecraft Monday youtube vid')
author: Rolofolo

generated.description: A large modern mansion built mostly from stone, white and black wool, sandstone and glass, with birch and jungle wood accents and a flat, layered roofline. It is roughly 51 by 61 blocks across and 32 blocks tall, with about 46,000 blocks total. Inside are chests, an enchanting table, furnaces, a cauldron, a record player and signs, and it sits on a mix of sand, grass and dirt terrain with a water feature.
